limitations: The Linux eviction hint is not equivalent to a reboot or privileged global page-cache drop.

methodology.evidence_note: Files without v2 in their name are exploratory JFM v1 optimization records. The five-sample v2 cold p95 fields equal the observed maxima and are not stable tail estimates.
